title: HOKA UTMB Mont-Blanc Training Plans with RunMotion Coach
claims: The official UTMB Mont-Blanc site offers free training-plan entry points through RunMotion Coach for ETC, MCC/OCC, CCC and UTMB/TDS.
The page describes progression, endurance and effort management as the framework of the standard plans, while a personalised plan adapts to goal, availability and terrain.
The UTMB/TDS plan is presented as preparation for the full loop around Mont-Blanc rather than a generic road marathon plan.

claimVerification.note: 页面列出 ETC、MCC & OCC、CCC、UTMB & TDS 四组免费计划入口。
页面写明标准计划提供 progression、endurance、effort management 框架。
UTMB/TDS 计划说明为 “Prepare for the ultimate adventure around Mont-Blanc”。
